# archestra_mcp_server_reinstall (Resource)

Re-deploys an installed MCP server (re-runs the K8s install) without recreating the install row. Maps to `POST /api/mcp_server/{id}/reinstall` — typically run after the parent `archestra_mcp_server_installation.reinstall_required` flips to true.

~> **One-shot.** Every attribute is `RequiresReplace`. Bumping `trigger` forces a re-deploy. The `archestra_mcp_server_installation` row is not touched.

```hcl
resource "archestra_mcp_server_reinstall" "refresh" {
  mcp_server_id = archestra_mcp_server_installation.api.id
  trigger       = "image-pull-2026-05-19"
}
```

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One-shot resource that re-deploys the K8s pod backing an MCP server
# installation without recreating the install row. Run this when the
# parent installation's `reinstall_required` flips to true (e.g. after
# a catalog-item template change).

resource "archestra_mcp_server_reinstall" "refresh" {
  mcp_server_id = archestra_mcp_server_installation.api.id
  trigger       = "image-pull-2026-05-19"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mcp_server_id` (String) UUID of the target MCP server installation.
- `trigger` (String) Opaque string the user bumps to force a re-deploy.

### Optional

- `environment_values` (Map of String) Replacement env vars. Omit to leave existing env unchanged.
- `is_byos_vault` (Boolean) When true, treat env/user-config values as vault references.
- `service_account` (String) K8s service-account override for the MCP server pod. Omit to keep the install-time value.
- `user_config_values` (Map of String) Replacement user-config values.

### Read-Only

- `executed_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the reinstall call.
- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier `<mcp_server_id>:<trigger>`.
